consultation.name: Gusuzuma
consultation.desc: Gusuzumwa na muganga n'isuzuma ryo gukurikirana, gahunda z'uwo munsi.

laboratory.name: Ibizamini
laboratory.desc: Malariya, ibipimo by'amaraso, isukari, inkari, SIDA n'ibindi — ibisubizo byinshi mu isaha imwe.

dental.name: Kuvura amenyo
dental.desc: Gusuzuma amenyo, kuyaziba, kuyakuramo no kuyasukura bikorwa n'umuganga w'amenyo.

ultrasound.name: Guca mu cyuma
ultrasound.desc: Ekografi y'umugore utwite n'iy'inda, hamwe na raporo yandikiwe muganga wawe.

nursing.name: Kwita ku barwayi
nursing.desc: Inshinge, gupfuka ibikomere, ibipimo n'ibitanda byo gukurikiranirwa igihe gito.

surgery.name: Kubaga byoroheje
surgery.desc: Kudoda ibikomere, gukuramo amashyira n'ibindi bikorwa bito hakoreshejwe ikinya cy'aho.

circ.name: Gusiramura
circ.desc: Gusiramura abahungu n'abagabo mu isuku n'umutekano, gusubira kwa muganga bikubiyemo.

fp.name: Kuboneza urubyaro
fp.desc: Inama mu ibanga n'uburyo bwose bugezweho bwo kuboneza urubyaro.

hiv.name: Ipimwa rya SIDA n'inkingo
hiv.desc: Gupima SIDA vuba hamwe n'inama, n'inkingo z'abana n'iz'abakuru.

signin.title: Abakozi: injira
signin.staffIdHint: Nimero wahawe n'umuyobozi. Hanyuma: izina ukoresha na PIN, nyuma kode yoherejwe kuri imeyili yawe.
signin.notStaff: Iyi nimero ntizwi. Baza umuyobozi w'ivuriro.
signin.sub: Sisitemu y'ivuriro · ku bakozi b'ivuriro gusa
signin.note: Ikora no ku bikoresho by'ivuriro bitari ku murongo. Kwinjira kose kurandikwa.
signin.unknown: Izina ukoresha ntirizwi. Konti z'igerageza: j.uwimana, c.nyirahabimana, b.mukamana, s.mugisha, t.mugabo, f.ndayisaba.
signin.failed: Izina ukoresha cyangwa PIN si byo. Ongera ugerageze cyangwa usabe umuyobozi kugusubiriza PIN.
signin.inactive: Iyi konti yahagaritswe. Baza umuyobozi w'ivuriro.

services.title: Ibyo dutanga
services.lead: Serivisi icyenda ahantu hamwe, ku buryo ingendo nyinshi zirangira uwo munsi. Umwakira akwemerera igiciro mbere y'uko usuzumwa.

book.title: Fata gahunda mu ntambwe eshatu
book.lead: Uwaje atafashe gahunda arakirwa buri gihe. Gufata gahunda mbere bigabanya igihe utegereza kandi bigafasha muganga gutegura dosiye yawe.
book.step1: Twandikire kuri WhatsApp cyangwa SMS izina ryawe, serivisi ukeneye n'umunsi n'isaha wifuza — cyangwa uhamagare ubwakiriro.
book.step2: Mu isaha imwe mu masaha y'akazi wakira ubutumwa bukwemeza isaha ya gahunda yawe na muganga uzakwakira.
book.step3: Zana indangamuntu yawe. Uhabwa nimero, ecran ikakwereka igihe kigeze.
book.emergency: Ntibikoreshwa ku byihutirwa. Niba hari uri mu kaga hamagara 912 (SAMU) cyangwa uze ku ivuriro ako kanya.
book.sent: Ubusabe bwoherejwe. Ubwakiriro buzakwemerera kuri {{channel}} mu isaha imwe mu masaha y'akazi.
book.sentRef: Ubusabe {{ref}} bwoherejwe. Ubwakiriro buzakwemerera kuri {{channel}} mu isaha imwe mu masaha y'akazi.
book.sendFailed: Ubusabe ntibwoherejwe. Reba umurongo wa interineti cyangwa uhamagare ubwakiriro.

insurance.title: Ubwishingizi twakira
insurance.soonLead: Ivuriro ntiriragirana amasezerano n'ubwishingizi. Kugeza ubu, buri ruzinduko rwishyurwa kuri kasiye — amafaranga, MTN MoMo cyangwa Airtel Money. Tuzatangaza hano ubwishingizi dufatanya na bwo amasezerano akimara gusinywa.
insurance.lead: Zana ikarita yawe n'indangamuntu; twishyuza ubwishingizi bwawe, wowe ukishyura umugabane wawe gusa kuri kasiye — amafaranga, MTN MoMo, Airtel Money, ikarita cyangwa banki.

footer.emergency: Ibyihutirwa? Hamagara 912 (SAMU) cyangwa uze ku ivuriro ako kanya.
footer.law: Amakuru y'abarwayi arinzwe n'Itegeko n° 058/2021 rirengera amakuru bwite n'ibanga.

doctors.lead: Gahunda ya buri muganga igaragara ku minsi irindwi iri imbere, muri buri serivisi. Hitamo igihe kiboneka, ubwakiriro bukakwemerera.
doctors.legend: Imibare ni ibihe biboneka uwo munsi ·

booking.title: Shaka muganga uhitemo isaha
booking.lead: Hitamo serivisi, hanyuma muganga; ibihe biboneka bigaragazwa ku minsi irindwi iri imbere. Ubwakiriro bwemeza buri busabe kuri WhatsApp, SMS cyangwa telefoni.
booking.labBody: Uza hagati ya 07:00 na 19:00 ufite urupapuro rwa muganga cyangwa usabe ikizamini ku bwakiriro. Ibisubizo byinshi biboneka mu isaha imwe.
booking.replyNote: Ubwakiriro busubiza mu isaha imwe mu masaha y'akazi. Ntibikoreshwa ku byihutirwa — hamagara 912.
booking.sentBody: {{doctor}} · {{when}}. Ubwakiriro buzakwemerera kuri WhatsApp cyangwa SMS. Zana indangamuntu yawe.
booking.sendFailed: Ubusabe ntibwoherejwe. Reba umurongo wa interineti cyangwa uhamagare ubwakiriro.

home.noCalendar: Nta murwayi wagufatiye gahunda uyu munsi.
home.quickNote: Utubuto dufite nibura 44 px kandi dusiga umwanya w'amagambo y'Ikinyarwanda / Igifaransa.
home.methodsHint: Ubwishyu bwemewe: amafaranga mu ntoki, MTN MoMo na Airtel Money.

staff.title: Abakozi
staff.lead: Buri mukozi ahabwa nimero y'umukozi, izina ukoresha, PIN ya mbere na imeyili. Kugira ngo yinjire yandika nimero y'umukozi ku rupapuro rusange, hanyuma izina ukoresha na PIN, nyuma kode yoherejwe kuri imeyili ye. Agomba guhindura PIN ku nshuro ya mbere yinjiye.
staff.noEmail: Nta imeyili — kode zo kwinjira ntizishobora koherezwa

emailCard.title: Imeyili ya {{name}}
emailCard.body: Kode y'imibare itandatu yo kwinjira yoherezwa kuri iyi aderesi buri gihe yinjiye.

form.usernameHint: Inyuguti nto, imibare, akadomo, akarongo cyangwa _ (3–32).
form.emailHint: Kode yo kwinjira yoherezwa hano buri gihe yinjiye. Koresha aderesi isomwa n'uyu mukozi wenyine.
form.usernameHint2: Rikomoka ku izina ariko rivanze (uko rikurikirana, inyuguti, umubare), ku buryo ridashobora gukekwa. Kanda "Tanga igitekerezo" ubone irindi, cyangwa wandike iryawe.
form.noDepartments: Nta mashami ariho: yafungure mu gice cy’Amashami, hanyuma ushyiremo abakozi.

created.title: Konti yafunguwe — biha {{name}} imbonankubone
created.note: PIN igaragara rimwe gusa. Umukozi yandika nimero y'umukozi ku rupapuro rusange, hanyuma izina ukoresha n'iyi PIN, nyuma kode yoherejwe kuri imeyili. Agomba guhindura PIN ku nshuro ya mbere yinjiye.

reset.title: Subiriza PIN ya {{name}}
reset.body: PIN nshya y'imibare itandatu isimbura iya kera ako kanya. Yimuhe imbonankubone; agomba kuyihindura ku nshuro ya mbere yinjiye.

errors.emailTaken: Iyi imeyili isanzwe ikoreshwa n'undi mukozi.
errors.roleDept: Uru ruhare ntirubarizwa muri iryo shami. Hitamo irindi shami cyangwa urwongere muri iryo shami.
errors.needDept: Hitamo ishami ku muyobozi cyangwa umwungirije.
errors.name: Andika amazina yombi.

staff.lead2: Fungura no guhindura konti z’abakozi, shyira buri wese mu ishami nk’umuyobozi, umwungirije cyangwa umunyamuryango, subiramo PIN kandi uhagarike konti. Buri mpinduka yemezwa na kode yoherejwe kuri e-mail yawe.

confirm.title: Emeza ukoresheje kode
confirm.hint: Kode igenzurirwa kuri seriveri kandi impinduka yandikwa mu izina ryawe. Ikora rimwe gusa kandi irangira nyuma y’iminota 10.
confirm.wrong: Iyo kode si yo cyangwa yarangiye. Nta cyahindutse.
confirm.required: Andika kode yaje kuri e-mail yawe kugira ngo ubike.
confirm.sending: Kode iri koherezwa kuri e-mail yawe…
confirm.sentTo: Twohereje kode kuri {{to}}. Yandike hano kugira ngo wemeze iyi mpinduka.
confirm.notSent: Kode ntiyashoboye koherezwa. Kanda « Ohereza indi ».
confirm.wait: Kode yoherejwe hashize umunota utarashira. Tegereza gato, hanyuma wohereze indi.

dept.lead: Fungura amashami y’ivuriro kandi uvuge inshingano zibarizwamo. Abakozi bashyirwa mu ishami nk’umuyobozi, umwungirije cyangwa umunyamuryango; umuyobozi abona imbonerahamwe y’ishami.
dept.confirmDelete_one: Gusiba "{{name}}"? Umukozi waryo {{count}} akomeza akazi, nta shami.
dept.confirmDelete_other: Gusiba "{{name}}"? Abakozi baryo {{count}} bakomeza akazi, nta shami.
dept.name: Izina ry’ishami
dept.rolesHint: Abakozi bafite izi nshingano ni bo bonyine bashobora gushyirwamo. Ntuhitemo na kimwe niba inshingano zose zemewe.

login.title: Abakozi: injira
login.lead: Andika izina ukoresha na PIN. Hanyuma twohereza kode y'imibare itandatu kuri imeyili yawe.
login.failed: Izina cyangwa PIN sibyo. Ongera ugerageze cyangwa usabe umuyobozi guhindura PIN.
login.inactive: Iyi konti yahagaritswe. Baza umuyobozi w'ivuriro.
login.codeLead: Twohereje kode y'imibare itandatu kuri {{email}}. Ikora iminota 10.
login.codeWrong: Kode sibyo. Reba imeyili yawe wongere ugerageze.
login.linkMismatch: Iyi link yo kwinjira ni iya {{got}}, si iya {{expected}}. Nta winjiye. Fungura imeyili iheruka koherezwa kuri {{expected}}, cyangwa wongere winjire.
login.codeOrLink: Imeyili iva kuri Muhazi Medical Clinic Ltd ifite umutwe "… is your sign-in code". Ikora iminota 10. Ntiyaje nyuma y'umunota umwe? Reba muri Spam cyangwa Promotions, cyangwa usabe indi kode.
login.error: Hari ikitagenze neza. Reba umurongo wa interineti wongere ugerageze.
login.otpSendFailed: Kode ntiyashoboye koherezwa kuri imeyili yawe. Saba umuyobozi agenzure aderesi yawe ya imeyili.
login.codeSample: Uburyo bw'igerageza: imibare itandatu iyo ari yo yose irakora.
login.trustHint: Ubutaha kuri iyi mashakisha, nimero y’umukozi, izina ukoresha na PIN birahagije — nta kode kuri imeyili kugeza igihe cyo kwizerwa kirangiye. Kuraho akamenyetso kuri mudasobwa ihuriweho.

register.title: Kwandika umurwayi
register.lead: Umurwayi mushya cyangwa uwari usanzwe. Mu buryo busanzwe umurwayi abanza kuri triage gupimwa; mu byihutirwa aguma aho uri maze ukamwandika hano.
register.emergency: Ikibazo cyihutirwa — umurwayi avurirwa hano, ntajya kuri triage
register.triageHint: Umurwayi ahabwa tike akajya kuri triage gupimwa bwa mbere.

done.title: Umurwayi yanditswe
done.where: Umurwayi yabitswe mu gitabo cy'abarwayi. Uruzinduko rwe rurafunguye kandi ari ku murongo wo gufatirwa ibipimo (ku muforomo), mbere yo kujya kwa muganga.
done.triageNote: Nimero yatanzwe. Umurwayi ajya gufatirwa ibipimo, hanyuma akajya aho agomba kuvurirwa.
done.emergencyNote: Ibyihutirwa: umurwayi ni we wa mbere ku murongo wa {{station}}.

register.emergencyHint: Umurwayi ashyizwe ku murongo w'aho ukorera ari mu ibara ritukura. Andika dosiye ubu cyangwa igihe umurwayi amaze gutekana.
register.searchLabel: Shakisha ukoresheje izina, nimero ya dosiye, telefoni cyangwa indangamuntu
register.noMatch: Nta murwayi wabonetse. Andika dosiye nshya iburyo.

errors.openVisit: Uyu murwayi asanzwe afite uruzinduko rufunguye.

triage.title: Triage · ibipimo bya mbere
triage.lead: Buri murwayi abanza hano. Fata ibipimo, hitamo ibara rya triage, wohereze umurwayi aho agomba kujya.
triage.select: Hitamo umurwayi ibumoso kugira ngo wandike ibipimo.
triage.readOnly: Abaforomo na ba muganga ni bo bonyine bandika ibipimo.

settings.title: Igenamiterere ry'ivuriro
settings.lead: Uyobora ivuriro ryose uhereye hano: umwirondoro n'aho twandikirwa bigaragara ku rubuga, amasaha dufungura, n'inzira zigana kuri buri gice.

profile.title: Umwirondoro w'ivuriro
profile.lead: Bigaragara ku rubuga rusange, ku nyemezabwishyu no mu butumwa. Impinduka zigaragara ako kanya.

hours.title: Amasaha dufungura
hours.lead: Kuri buri munsi: amasaha 24, amasaha wihitiyemo cyangwa rirafunze. Laboratwari ifite amasaha yayo.

patientFields.title: Ibice bya dosiye y'umurwayi
patientFields.lead: Ongeraho amakuru ivuriro ryifuza kuri buri dosiye y'umurwayi arenze asanzwe (idini, indwara idakira, umuntu wa hafi, nimero y'ikarita y'ubwishingizi…). Abakozi bayuzuza kuri dosiye y'umurwayi.
patientFields.label: Izina ry'igice
patientFields.optionsPh: Nta yo, Diyabete, Umuvuduko w'amaraso, SIDA, Asima
patientFields.saved: Ibice byabitswe. Ubu bigaragara kuri buri dosiye y'umurwayi.

lock.title: Gufunga ecran
lock.lead: Iyo nta muntu ukoze kuri ecran y'umukozi muri iki gihe, irifunga igasaba PIN. Umunota umwe mbere, haza integuza; gukoraho cyangwa gukanda bituma igumaho. Gufunga bigumana urupapuro uko rwari ruri, nta kazi kabura.
lock.saved: Byabitswe. Kuva ubu ecran zose z'abakozi zirabikoresha.

otp.title: Kode yo kwinjira kuri imeyili
otp.lead: Kode zoherezwa na Gmail y’ivuriro, yemera imeyili nka 500 ku munsi. Nyuma ya kode imwe nyayo umuntu ashobora kwizera igikoresho cye; kuri icyo gikoresho nimero y’umukozi, izina ukoresha na PIN biba bihagije kugeza igihe cyo kwizerwa kirangiye.
otp.days_one: Rimwe kuri buri gikoresho, hanyuma cyizerwa umunsi {{count}}
otp.days_other: Rimwe kuri buri gikoresho, hanyuma cyizerwa iminsi {{count}}
otp.revokeAll: Ongera usabe kode ku bikoresho byose
otp.saved: Byabitswe. Birakurikizwa uhereye ku kwinjira gukurikira.
otp.hint: Koresha "Ongera usabe kode ku bikoresho byose" iyo telefoni cyangwa mudasobwa ibuze, cyangwa umukozi avuye mu ivuriro.

pin.changeLead: Winjiye ukoresheje PIN wahawe n'umuyobozi. Yisimbuze imibare itandatu uzi wenyine.
pin.failed: PIN ntiyashoboye guhindurwa. Reba PIN isanzwe wongere ugerageze.

lock.title: Byafunzwe nyuma y'iminota 5
lock.soon_one: Nta gikorwa: ecran irifunga mu isegonda {{count}}.
lock.soon_other: Nta gikorwa: ecran irifunga mu masegonda {{count}}.

add.adjustHint: Si ngombwa. Andika 10 kuri 10 %, hitamo RWF ku mafaranga, cyangwa × ku kigwizo.

errors.noManual: Ubu buvuzi ntibwemera ikindi giciro. Koresha igabanywa, cyangwa usabe umuyobozi gushyiraho "Muganga ashobora kwandika ikindi giciro".
errors.discount: Igabanywa ni ijanisha riri hagati ya 0 na 100.
errors.overMax: Ushobora gutanga kugeza kuri {{pct}}% kuri ubu buvuzi. Saba umuyobozi kurenzaho.

payer.label: Uwishyura
payer.hint: Guhitamo ubwishingizi byongera kugabanya buri cyishyurwa kuri iyi fagitire hakurikijwe ibyo bwishyura.
payer.noInsurers: Nta bwishingizi burakora: umurwayi yishyura amafaranga yose kuri kasiye.

payment.title: Kwishyura
payment.nothingYet: Nta cyishyurwa kiraba kuri uru ruzinduko.

next.title: Byarangiye kuri iyi serivisi
next.lead: Bifunga umurongo wa {{station}} kandi bikohereza umurwayi aho akurikira.

patients.title: Abarwayi
patients.lead: Abarwayi bose ivuriro ryanditse. Fungura dosiye urebe ingendo, ibipimo, indwara na fagitire, uhindure amakuru cyangwa utangire uruzinduko rushya.
patients.none: Nta murwayi uhuye n'ubushakashatsi. Reba uko izina ryanditswe cyangwa umwandike.

file.visitStarted: Uruzinduko rwatangiye. Nimero {{ticket}}, ari ku murongo wa {{station}}.
file.moreLead: Ibice umuyobozi yongeyeho mu Igenamiterere bigaragara hano kuri buri murwayi. Ushobora no kongeraho igice cyihariye cy'uyu murwayi gusa.
file.fieldNamePh: urugero: Umuntu wa hafi, Idini, Nimero y'ikarita y'ubwishingizi
file.noExtra: Nta yandi makuru araba. Koresha “Ongeraho igice”, cyangwa umuyobozi ashyireho ibice bya buri murwayi mu Igenamiterere.
file.allergiesHint: Imiti, ibiryo cyangwa ibindi bitera umubiri kwivumbura (uduheri, kubyimba, guhumeka nabi) gusa. Ibindi bivugwa bijya mu Byitonderwa.
file.inClinicNow: Uyu murwayi ari mu ivuriro ubu, ategereje kuri {{station}}. Akabuto k'ubururu gafungura urwo ruzinduko: ibipimo, ibyanditswe, indwara, ubuvuzi, imiti n'ubwishyu byose byandikwa aho.

clinical.title: Inyandiko z'ubuvuzi
clinical.readOnly: Ba muganga, abaforomo n'umuyobozi ni bo bonyine bandika mu nyandiko z'ubuvuzi.
clinical.notePh: Icyamuzanye, amateka, ibyagaragaye mu isuzuma, gahunda…
clinical.testSaved: Ikizamini cyasabwe, cyishyuzwa kandi gishyirwa ku murongo.
clinical.finishHint: Indwara y'ingenzi irakenewe. Niba hari amafaranga atarishyurwa, umurwayi yoherezwa kuri kasiye.
clinical.finishConfirm: Gusoza uru ruzinduko? Ibizamini bitararangira biguma bifunguye; fagitire itishyuwe yohereza umurwayi kuri kasiye.

errors.needPrimary: Andika indwara y'ingenzi mbere yo gusoza uruzinduko.

clinical.dxHint: Indwara ni icyo wabonye nyuma yo gusuzuma umurwayi, urugero “Malariya yoroheje”. Iy'ingenzi = impamvu nyamukuru y'uru ruzinduko; iyindi = ibindi bibazo byabonetse. Kanda “By'agateganyo” igihe ugitegereje ibisubizo.
clinical.rxHint: Igice kimwe kuri buri muti. Koresha “Ongeraho undi muti” ku miti ifatanywa (urugero umuti wa malariya na parasetamoli). Yose yoherezwa muri farumasi icyarimwe.
clinical.rxSaved_one: Umuti wanditswe. Umurwayi ari ku murongo wa farumasi.
clinical.rxSaved_other: Imiti {{count}} yanditswe. Umurwayi ari ku murongo wa farumasi.

errors.invalid: Ako gaciro ntikakora hano. Reba umubare n'uburyo (%, RWF, ×).

visits.title: Mu ivuriro
visits.lead: Abarwayi bose bafite uruzinduko rufunguye uyu munsi, bakurikijwe aho bari ubu. Fungura uruzinduko uvure, wishyuze cyangwa wohereze umurwayi; agashushanyo ka dosiye gafungura dosiye y'umurwayi.
visits.none: Nta murwayi uri mu ivuriro ubu. Andika umurwayi kugira ngo utangire uruzinduko.

prices.confirmDelete: Gusiba "{{name}}"? Biva ku rutonde rwose. Fagitire zabukoresheje zirabugumana.
prices.maxDiscountTitle: Igabanywa rinini muganga ashobora gutanga kuri ubu buvuzi

adjust.title: Hindura ibiciro byinshi icyarimwe
adjust.lead: Zamura cyangwa umanure igiciro cy'ubuvuzi bwose, cyangwa cy'itsinda rimwe, icyarimwe. Ubuvuzi bw'ubuntu buguma ari ubuntu.
adjust.invalid: Andika umubare ukwiye kuri ubu buryo bwo guhindura.

form.suggested: Amazina mu Kinyarwanda no mu Gifaransa yasabwe hashingiwe ku Cyongereza. Yakosore niba atari byo ushaka kuvuga.
form.maxDiscountNone: Umuyobozi wenyine ni we ushobora gutanga igabanywa kuri ubu buvuzi.
form.allowManual: Muganga ashobora kwandika ikindi giciro (atanze impamvu)
form.allowManualHint: Ku buvuzi igiciro cyabwo gihinduka, nko kubaga cyangwa gupfuka igikomere igihe kirekire. Ku rupapuro rw'uruzinduko muganga ashobora kwandika ikindi giciro aho kuba icyo ku rutonde, akavuga impamvu. Umuyobozi abishobora igihe cyose.
form.activeHint: Kuramo akamenyetso uhishe ubu buvuzi ku rupapuro rw'uruzinduko utabusibye, urugero igihe imashini yapfuye. Amateka yabwo agumaho.
form.insurerPrices: Ibiciro by'ubwishingizi (siga ubusa ukoreshe igiciro gisanzwe)

insurers.parked: Ubwishingizi burahagaritswe: ivuriro ntirirakorana n'ubwishingizi, bityo abarwayi bose bishyura amafaranga cyangwa mobile money. Ibiciro n'ibyo ubwishingizi bwishyura bizagaragara hano ubufatanye bwa mbere nibutangira.
insurers.title: Ubwishingizi n'ibyo bwishyura
insurers.lead: Ubwishingizi ivuriro rikorana na bwo n'ibyo buri bumwe bwishyura. Ijanisha rya buri tsinda risimbura irusange (urugero amenyo 50%). Ubwishingizi bukora ni bwo bwonyine bushobora guhitwamo ku ruzinduko.

form.name: Izina
form.byGroup: Ibyo bwishyura kuri buri tsinda (si ngombwa, bisimbura % rusange)
form.publicNote: Urubuga rusange rugumana itangazo "ubwishingizi buraza vuba" kugeza FEATURES.insurance ifunguwe muri kode.

errors.discount: Igabanywa rigomba kuba 0–100 %, ritarenze igiciro muri RWF, cyangwa ikigwizo kiri hagati ya 0 na 1.
errors.name: Izina rirakenewe.
errors.price: Igiciro kigomba kuba umubare wuzuye w'amafaranga, zeru cyangwa irenga.
errors.coverage: Ibyo bwishyura ni ijanisha riri hagati ya 0 na 100.

prices.leadCash: Ibyo ivuriro rivura byose, igiciro cyabyo n'igabanywa muganga ashobora gutanga atakubajije. Shakisha, koporora, hisha, siba cyangwa uhindure ibiciro byinshi icyarimwe.
prices.title: Ubuvuzi, ibiciro n'ubwishingizi
prices.lead: Ibyo ivuriro rivura byose, igiciro cyabyo n'igabanywa muganga ashobora gutanga atakubajije. Ubwishingizi mukorana bugira ibiciro byabwo n'ibyo bwishyura.

desk.busiest: Isaha yaje abantu benshi kugeza ubu: {{hour}} (abarwayi {{count}}).

receptionist.subtitle: Ubwakiriro
receptionist.inquiriesHint: Ubusabe bwa gahunda buvuye ku rubuga cyangwa kuri telefoni. Hamagara wemeze isaha.

nurse.subtitle: Ubuforomo
nurse.urgencyHint: Amabara aturuka ku ifatwa ry'ibipimo. Abafite ibara ritukura bakirwa mbere kuri buri serivisi.

vitalsForm.selfHint: Wapimye ubu. Niba wandika ibyo umuforomo yanditse ku rupapuro, hitamo izina rye n'isaha yanditse.
vitalsForm.paperHint: Biva ku rupapuro: ibipimo bibikwa nk'ibyafashwe n'uyu muforomo kuri iyi saha, kandi nk'ibyanditswe nawe.

errors.future: Isaha byapimiwe iri mu gihe kizaza.

appts.title: Gahunda
appts.lead: Abarwayi bafashe gahunda z'uyu munsi n'ubusabe bwa gahunda bwo gusubiza.
appts.arrivedHint: Umurwayi yahageze: bifungura uruzinduko bikamushyira ku murongo w'ibipimo ku muforomo.
appts.registerFirst: Banza wandike umurwayi: iyi gahunda nta dosiye y'umurwayi irafite.
appts.flow: Uko bihuzwa: ubusabe bwemejwe butegereza ko muganga abwemera; ku munsi nyirizina, "Yaje" ifungura uruzinduko maze umurwayi akagaragara ku murongo w'ibipimo ku muforomo; nyuma y'ibipimo umuforomo amwohereza kwa muganga.

inquiries.hint: Kwemeza bihuza ubusabe na dosiye y'umurwayi (hakoreshejwe telefoni) bikabwoherereza muganga ngo abwemere.

tasks.whatPh: urugero: Urushinge: ceftriaxone 1 g IM, ongera upime
tasks.sent: Byoherejwe. Biri ku mbonerahamwe y'abaforomo ubu.

beds.nobody: Nta murwayi uri mu ivuriro wo gushyira ku gitanda
beds.confirmDischarge: Gusezerera {{name}} kuri iki gitanda? Igitanda kijya gusukurwa.

files.title: Dosiye zo kuzuza
files.completeNow: Dosiye yuzuye. Ohereza umurwayi kwa muganga.
files.hint: Umuforomo yanditse aba barwayi akoresheje ibyo yashoboye. Andika telefoni, indangamuntu n'aho atuye, hanyuma wohereze umurwayi kwa muganga.
files.sendToReception: Ubwakiriro buzuzuza dosiye ({{missing}}) mbere yo kujya kwa muganga.
files.sentToDoctor: Yoherejwe kwa muganga. Muganga amubona ku murongo.
files.nurseHint: Uzuza ibyo uzi (izina, igitsina, imyaka). Ubwakiriro buzuzuza telefoni, indangamuntu n'aho atuye nyuma y'ibipimo byawe.
files.receptionHint: Uzuza ibyo ushoboye byose. Niba umuforomo yamaze kwandika umurwayi, mushakishe ibumoso aho gufungura dosiye ya kabiri.

textSize.lead: Bituma inyandiko, utumenyetso n’utubuto twa buri paji y’abakozi biba binini cyangwa bito kuri iyi mudasobwa.
